About & focus

What I work on

From a PhD in computational science to production ML at Uber, AWS, Walmart and Bayer — I build models that ship: foundation-model embeddings, LLM evaluation pipelines, recommenders, and forecasting systems.

🧠

Deep Learning

Neural models in PyTorch — from multi-modal foundation-model embeddings at Uber to force prediction in particulate multiphase flows.

✦

Generative AI / LLMs

LLM pipelines for evaluation, explainability and agents — context engineering, structured prompting, RAG, and LLM-powered SQL agents.

▦

Large-Scale ML & Data

Training and scoring at scale with Spark, PySpark and Airflow, and careful handling of class imbalance and rare events.

⇄

Transformers & Evaluation

Transformer architectures (Qwen3, GPT, BERT, T5), Flash-Attention, and rigorous evaluation — PR-AUC, precision, BLEU / ROUGE.

⚡

Fine-tuning & Production

Fine-tuning and LoRA / PEFT on SageMaker and Bedrock, with production implementation in Python and C++ — rooted in an HPC background.

Earlier research — still below in the publications — followed how things move through air and fluid: coughs and sneezes, droplet nuclei, shocks and turbulence, studied with high-accuracy simulation and learning-based models. That modelling discipline carries into the industry work above.
